title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Counting of Lost Days by How the Unit Came Back
content:
For a Ridgeline Tool Rental breakdown reported after the day of checkout, the lost days of the downtime credit are counted according to how the unit came back.

**Counting rule.** How the lost days are counted after a report made later than the checkout date depends on how the unit came back: for a unit Ridgeline delivered to the job site, the lost days are the calendar days from the report date to the return date with both dates counted; for a unit the renter collected, returned on a calendar day after the due-back date, the lost days are the calendar days from the report date to the due-back date; for any other unit, the lost days are the calendar days from the report date to the return date.

A unit Ridgeline delivered to the job site is one whose agreement records job-site delivery as booked; a unit the renter collected is one whose agreement does not. The report date is the date of the most recent malfunction report on the agreement; the due-back and return dates are the date parts of those times on the agreement.

## Counting table

| How the unit came back | Returned after the due-back date | Lost days |
|---|---|---|
| delivered to the job site | either | report date to return date, both dates counted |
| collected by the renter | yes | report date to due-back date |
| collected by the renter | no | report date to return date |

## Hypothetical dates (checked out 1 March, report 5 March, due back 8 March)

| How the unit came back | Returned | Lost days |
|---|---|---|
| delivered to the job site | 10 March | 5 to 10 March with both counted: 6 |
| collected by the renter | 10 March | 5 to 8 March: 3 |
| collected by the renter | 8 March | 5 to 8 March: 3 |
| collected by the renter | 7 March | 5 to 7 March: 2 |
| delivered to the job site | 8 March | 5 to 8 March with both counted: 4 |
